operation.summary: Propose a new version of this personal applet. Read its development snapshot, validate the complete candidate and include change evidence. The owner or an authorized controlling agent reviews every agent edit. Approval checks the expected instance revision again.

body.name: package
body.description: The applet file itself: a bridgit-template/1 definition with runtime.adapter bridgit.package.v1 (legacy alias android.package.v1; see https://bridgit.cc/learn/builder/applet-packages.md)

body.name: url
body.description: Instead of package: an https://bridgit.cc/… package file (for example a recipe's applet.json)

body.name: template
body.description: Instead of package: a template registry key (with revision)

body.name: bundled
body.description: Instead of package/url/template: a built-in applet id (including a-sorta-fairytale-about-me, chef-helper, insurance-inventory, exercise-check); downloads its registry release

body.name: config
body.description: Values for the applet's blanks (config_schema); the rest use defaults. The owner can still change them on the review screen

body.name: practice_review
body.description: Reported GLM practice review: model, source_sha256 and disposition, or unavailable status and reason

body.name: change
body.description: Required for agent edits: expected_revision, intent (1-1000 chars), acceptance (1-20 behavioral checks), evidence (1-4000 chars); task_id when integrating a prepared template. Read the modification guide first

operation.example: POST /v1/applets/installed/ai0123456789abcd/update {"template":"my-notebook","revision":2,"change":{"expected_revision":3,"intent":"Keep an extra month of notes","acceptance":["Existing notes remain readable"],"evidence":"Dry run passed and previous notes reopened on the test instance."}}
operation.returns: status awaiting_owner, pending_id and review. After the owner or delegated controller approves through /owner/configuration/approvals, read back the installed version and data.
